blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Energy chief Alfonso Cusi on Monday asked the Sandiganbayan Third Division for permission to travel to China and Japan starting Oct. 31. According to Jezreel Zapanta of the Office of the Special Prosecutor, Cusi’s motion did not specify the duration of his stay or his return date, although the trip would last less than 30 days. Zapanta opposed the request, noting that Cusi planned to attend an import-export fair in China and a food fair in Japan.
